annotations.title: China Work Permit Score Deficit Analyzer & Upgrade Levers

description: Diagnose exact point gaps below Category B (60) or Category A (85) thresholds and rank concrete SAFEA upgrade levers such as HSK certification, >=9-month service commitment, university ranking bonus, and salary restructuring.

age.description: Applicant age bracket at time of SAFEA work permit filing.

bonus.description: Already claimed +5pt SAFEA bonus items to avoid double counting upgrades.

chinese.description: Current HSK Mandarin proficiency test level held by applicant.

cityTier.description: City wage tier benchmark used to compute 5x-6x salary bracket thresholds.

education.description: Current highest authenticated academic degree credential.

experience.description: Current post-graduation relevant full-time work experience years.

location.description: Current employment city incentive classification under SAFEA rubric.

salary.description: Current gross annual RMB salary tier from employment contract.
